english.title: Fail to give information required under section 93G
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a relevant person upon whom a notice had been served under section 93G of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, failed without reasonable excuse to give the information required by the notice, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..), within the period of 21 days beginning with the day on which it was served
english.legislation: Contrary to section 93G(7) and (9) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
